verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs say flags, experiments, and deployments can be managed "from CI, scripts, or your own tools" through the Experiment APIs. The Management API also lets you create and control flags, experiments, holdouts, and mutex groups programmatically, and an OpenAPI spec is published. That covers headless, CI-driven automation. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action or example workflow), documented auth/token setup for CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
Use the Experiment management API to programmatically create and control flags and experiments.
Holdout APIs to create, edit, and display holdout groups and their properties.
